parameters.name: AppIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the baseline applications.

parameters.name: EntryAppId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: EntryAppType
parameters.description:
The type of the gateway that acts as the application's entry point.

- **apig:** cloud-native API gateway

- **mse:** java service gateway

- **mse-gw:** MSE Cloud Native Gateway

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the swimming lane group. This parameter is required when you update a swimming lane group.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the swimming lane group.

parameters.name: SwimVersion
parameters.description: The version of the end-to-end canary release. Valid values: 0 and 2. The value 2 is recommended.
